title: Jerusalem in Stone: A Life from Daybreak to Starlight
summary: One persistent limestone miniature carries Jerusalem’s life story from documented Jaffa Gate at daybreak through green parks, sacred landmarks and the Mount of Olives, as light turns to starlight.

fields.director_notes: Prompt: Adapt manhattan-miniature into a 60s diorama film of Jerusalem connecting documented Jaffa Gate through parks and public spaces to the Mount of Olives under changing day and night light. MiniMax M3.1 Flash role: Directed narrative structure, landmark sequencing, bilingual subtitles, and day-to-night lighting choreography. Diorama: 3D interactive diorama with custom limestone materials, road networks, and day/night transitions. Audio: MiniMax Speech 2.8 HD English narration synchronized to landmark flights. Human involvement: Camera choreography, timing alignment, subtitle muxing, and verification.
fields.my_city_line: Jerusalem: stone, paths, and the endless light
